fields.description: Credits granted once, on signup. 0 = no grant.
fields.label: Signup Grant Credits

fields.description: Charged for a custom image build, on cache miss only. 0 = builds are free.
fields.label: Custom Build Credits

fields.description: Warn the user once the balance drops below this percent of their last purchase. 0 = never warn.
fields.label: Low Balance Warn Percent

fields.description: Hard TTL: a running instance is auto-stopped after this many hours. 0 = unlimited.
fields.label: Max Run Hours

fields.description: A stopped instance is deleted after this many days. 0 = never reap.
fields.label: Reap After Days

fields.description: Concurrent running instances for a user who has never purchased. 0 = unlimited.
fields.label: Max Concurrent (Free)

fields.description: Concurrent running instances for a user who has purchased. 0 = unlimited.
fields.label: Max Concurrent (Paid)

fields.description: Custom image builds per user per day. 0 = unlimited.
fields.label: Max Builds per Day

fields.description: Monthly price per instance, in INR, to exempt it from the TTL auto-stop. 0 = the pass is not sold.
fields.label: Always On Monthly (INR)

fields.description: While this is on, the landing page shows the waitlist form and self-serve signup is refused. Turn it off to open signup to anyone: the CTA becomes Start free and the waitlist refuses instead. Its rows are kept either way.
fields.label: Waitlist Open

fields.description: One domain per line. An email signup from any of these is refused. OAuth signups are not checked — the provider has already vouched for the account.
fields.label: Blocked Email Domains

fields.description: The duration a deploy buys when neither the lab nor its size names one.
fields.label: Default Lease Plan

fields.description: Most expired leases one sweep may claim. Each claim queues a stop, and the stop queue is the ceiling.
fields.label: Lease Sweep Batch

fields.description: How long a claimed stop may sit before another sweep re-queues it. A worker killed mid-batch strands its claims otherwise.
fields.label: Lease Reclaim Seconds

fields.description: Failed expiry stops before the lease is parked. A parked row is an error state, not a silence.
fields.label: Lease Max Attempts
